steps.en: Download the installer on a Docker host and run it
steps.zh: 在装了 Docker 的主机上下载并运行安装脚本

steps.en: Writes .env with random secrets and starts the stack at 127.0.0.1:5173
steps.zh: 生成带随机密钥的 .env，在 127.0.0.1:5173 拉起整套服务

steps.en: Create an account, connect a model, create a bot and brief it
steps.zh: 注册账号、接入模型、建一个 bot 并交代任务

steps.en: Runs the bot's Pi session against its own Linux computer: browser, desktop, shell
steps.zh: 用 Pi 会话驱动这个 bot 自己的 Linux 电脑：浏览器、桌面、终端

steps.en: Checkpoints the workspace and browser profiles to DATA_DIR after each run
steps.zh: 每次运行结束把工作区和浏览器配置存回 DATA_DIR

steps.en: Step in when it asks for a login or approval, or take over its screen
steps.zh: 它要登录或要批准时出手，或直接接管它的屏幕

value.en: You brief a bot once and close the app; it keeps working on a computer that remembers its logins, on hardware and models you chose
value.zh: 交代一次就能关掉应用，bot 在一台记得登录态的电脑上继续干活，硬件和模型都是你选的

sources: https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/blob/main/README.md Quick start (published images): install-images.sh, bash install-images.sh, creates .env with random secrets, http://127.0.0.1:5173, create an account, connect a model, create your first bot

https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/blob/main/docs/computer-runtime.md (one Pi agent session -> computer tools -> SandboxProvider; Docker default; per-bot Chrome profile; checkpoints into AgentHomeStore / DATA_DIR at run completion)
https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/blob/main/VISION.md (bot asks for help only for information, judgment, authorization, or protected input; user takeover of one bot's screen)
